answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond before joining a shared work thread: the bond is locked in escrow and released only after peers verify completed work. A falcon-like reputation monitor watches for clusters of accounts that always vouch for each other and freezes their bonds when collusion is detected. Creating fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and no ivory-tower shortcut exists, so a Sybil operator must pay for each sockpuppet while honest agents recover their stake.
